jobs.prompt: Transform this exact photo of a storefront into a cinematic golden-hour dreamscape. Keep the building exactly as photographed: the single-storey red-brick facade, the white soffit roof edge, the glass entrance door on the left, the dark red sign that reads exactly "Elevated Dreams", the window with the green "DISPENSARY NOW OPEN" banner and the small "DISPENSARY" sign, the white downspout, the black handrail and the flower bed. Do not change, add or misspell any lettering. Remove the parking lot, sidewalk and trees: the building now floats on a sea of soft, sunlit clouds. Thick billowing clouds fill the whole foreground and hide the ground, wisps of cloud drift in front of the base of the building, and cloud banks recede into the distance under a vast golden-hour sky: low sun glowing from the left, warm amber and peach light, soft pink near the horizon, deepening to violet high in the sky. Warm golden light rakes across the brick, long soft shadows, glowing reflections in the window glass. Wide cinematic composition, the building centred slightly right and fully visible with room around it, generous open sky above and to the left. Photographic, dreamy, anamorphic film look, gentle atmospheric haze, fine 35mm film grain. No people, no cars, no extra text, no logos.

Reimagine this exact storefront photo as a surreal, cinematic still: the same single-storey red-brick building, kept exactly as photographed, with its dark red sign reading exactly "Elevated Dreams", the glass door on the left, the window with the green "DISPENSARY NOW OPEN" banner, the white roof edge, downspout and handrail, now drifting high above a vast golden-hour cloudscape. The ground is gone: a deep layer of luminous cumulus clouds wraps the base of the building and spills toward the camera, soft cloud wisps pass in front of the lower windows. The sun sits low behind the clouds on the left, flooding the scene with warm honey-gold light and long rays through the haze; the upper sky fades from apricot to dusky lavender. The camera is slightly lower than the original, looking up a little, so the building feels elevated. Do not alter or add any lettering. Photographic, cinematic colour grade, soft bloom on highlights, film grain, generous empty sky in the upper left. No people, no cars, no extra text, no logos.
